This document supplies the prospective evidence, execution, traceability, and verdict procedure. If an
engineering observation appears to require changing science, record a deviation and return it to scientiﬁc-
owner review; do not edit the expected result in this view.

1 Purpose and conformance target
This speciﬁcation tells a reviewer how to decide whether one exact candidate conforms to SCI-MAP v0.2. It does
not select a candidate, inspect an implementation, execute validation, or assert a result. Before work begins, the
reviewer freezes:
• repository and immutable candidate identity;
• build proﬁle, compiler/runtime identities, conﬁguration, and enabled parallel modes;
• exact input ﬁxtures and independent expected-value generators;
• numerical comparison policy and simultaneous statistical error policy;
• required product list, representation paths, log policy, and completion criteria; and
• the shared-authority digest, contract version, this document revision, owner-decision ledger revision, exact
byte-identical PTC-to-MAP boundary digest, exact original-footprint-coordinate boundary, source-bound MAP
proﬁle versions and their six separate status axes, six product-role identities, coadd Registry record, owner
r0.4 directive identity/digest, and the exact candidate paired SCI-VAL_PROFILE_REGISTRY v0.1/r0.3-map-v0.2-r0.4-
candidate-2026-09-08 and SCI-VAL_SOURCE_BINDING_REGISTER v0.1/r0.3-map-v0.2-r0.4-candidate-2026-09-08 records.
Candidate records are not treated as owner-accepted, canonically activated, or frozen merely because their bytes
and hashes are complete.
Evidence from a diﬀerent candidate, conﬁguration, or science-authority digest is not silently pooled. Each rerun
keeps its own identity and reason. Historical operational acceptance does not substitute for conformance evidence.
The complete ordered MAP lifecycle, its independent attempt outcome, and its record rules appear once in the
following lifecycle table.
MAP stage Exact meaning Record rule
requested Immutable accepted intent. Exists only for an accepted request; it is
never reconstructed from a later stage.

request.

Supplies the exact value/state for

was invoked or committed for one execution

The MAP plan, coeﬃcient selection/application, projection, support policy, output/coadd plan, response/covariance request,
product role, and coverage_cut use this same ordering. Each parameter stage binds its exact value and provenance; a
completed realization contains all ﬁve stages, while a nonproducing attempt contains only stages actually reached.
The MAP lifecycle does not replace the independently named PTC/V AL handoﬀ axes requested/not_requested,
applicable/inapplicable/applicability_unknown, eligible/ineligible/decision_unavailable, and
realized/incomplete/failed/not_produced. It also does not replace the ECS requirement-result vocabulary or
evidence- artifact realization state. In particular, a MAP parameter’s resolved or applied value may be checked
before application or bound after application; its realized value is never a prerequisite for a pre-application check.
MAP product realization and application-attempt outcome are independent. succeeded means the requested im-
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 2

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Engineering Conformance Speciﬁcation Document r0.4
mutable MAP product was realized. failed means the attempt terminated at an exact failure stage and retains cause,
aﬀected scope, and nonmutation evidence without a realized MAP product or completion marker. not_produced
means no MAP product was realized without asserting producer failure; the authorized empty-support case uses this
value. A response or covariance status of unavailable inside a permitted realized base bundle is a companion-status
fact, not attempt failure. Evidence-artifact realization is another independent axis.
For the r0.4 generation, the proposed owner-governed MAP proﬁle semantics are candidate; scientiﬁc-owner
approval is pending; canonical Registry registration is pending; source binding is pending; SCI-V AL activa-
tion/evaluability is unavailable; and an object-speciﬁc decision realization is unavailable. In particular,
SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 is the proposed owner-governed aggregate-proﬁle identity for this candidate.
After exact owner acceptance, canonical Registry/source binding, and activation, SCI-V AL may evaluate it for a
requested object. The same candidate-generation separation applies to SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2. Earlier
exact proﬁle approvals and evaluations retain their own immutable source generations; this candidate does not
rebind or relabel them.
Exact empty-support disposition. The 2026-09-08 owner directive selects for this r0.4 candidate the follow-
ing empty-support disposition; ﬁnal acceptance of these exact r0.4 bytes remains pending. If a valid applied sup-
port policy yields Sout = ∅, or a valid applied coadd support policy yields S c
out = ∅, the application state is
applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows, the product and attempt outcome is not_produced, and the ex-
act cause is no_support_authorized_output_rows. The record retains request, eﬀective, observation-resolved, and
applied stages; exact parent and plan; coeﬃcient, projection, support, role and proﬁle identities; Q⋆, thresholds
and support predicates; proof that the output-row set is empty; attempt identity, cause, and provenance. It has
no realized MAP product or completion marker and publishes no dense zero map, zero-sky measurement, valid
ordinary signal plane, no-row coadd member, or fabricated response/covariance plane. No immutable empty-row
scientiﬁc-bundle alternative is authorized.
2 Evidence record
Each requirement record contains at least:
Field Required content
Requirement Stable SCI-MAP-REQ-NNN and shared-authority digest.
Candidate Exact source/build identity and environment proﬁle.
Observable Public product, typed state, API boundary, metadata, diagnostic, or failure
transition under test.
Fixture Immutable input identity and independent expected-value calculation.
Comparison Exact predicate or preregistered numerical/statistical bound.
Result Exactly one of pass, fail, blocked, not_applicable, or not_assessed.
Skipped required evidence is not_assessed, never a pass.
Artifact realization Exactly one of complete, incomplete, failed, or not_produced; this
records the evidence artifact and never substitutes for the requirement
result.
MAP attempt outcome Exactly one of succeeded, failed, or not_produced, independently of
evidence-artifact realization.
MAP product realization Exact immutable product identity and all ﬁve lifecycle stages only when
actual accumulators, scientiﬁc rows, values, role-qualiﬁed statuses, and
provenance were produced; otherwise absent.
Failure/nonproduction
record
Reached lifecycle preﬁx, attempt identity, stage/cause/scope, provenance,
and nonmutation evidence. A failure record does not realize a MAP
product; no-support nonproduction is not failure.
Artifacts Machine-readable outputs, logs, traces, plots/tables where needed, and
digest-addressed provenance.
Reviewer Independent reviewer identity, date, and deviation disposition.
Every ECS requirement result is exactly one of pass, fail, blocked, not_applicable, or not_assessed. pass
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 3

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Engineering Conformance Speciﬁcation Document r0.4
means complete positive evidence establishes the requirement for the exact candidate. fail means evaluated evi-
dence contradicts it. blocked means evaluation cannot proceed because one exact named authority, dependency,
proﬁle, source binding, or prerequisite is unavailable. not_applicable means the requirement is outside the exact
candidate’s declared role under an owner-approved rationale. not_assessed means applicable evidence has not
yet been executed or reviewed. Evidence-artifact realization is a diﬀerent axis with values complete, incomplete,
failed, and not_produced.
Failures are retained as evidence. A tolerance, ﬁxture, expected result, or applicability decision is not changed after
viewing a failure without opening a new preregistered record.

All nine stable MAP scope decisions are decided for this candidate. A claim may still be blocked by an unapproved
source binding, an unavailable producer, or missing conformance evidence; record that state without weakening the
requirement or substituting a fallback.
4 Execution order and atomicity protocol
Run evidence in the following order so later evidence cannot mask an earlier contract failure:
1. Stage A—structural. Parse and freeze exact identity and parent, generation, source/proﬁle binding, producer
availability, and required decision realization for frozen PTC r0.5, the exact PTC-to-MAP boundary, and the
AST same- n signal coordinate, all boundaries/proﬁles, units, lifecycle, WCS, MAP policy, and required-product
plan. When the uniform route is selected, require the exact uniform Registry, family, and handoﬀ identities
declared in the shared authority; selection alone supplies no coeﬃcient and creates no default. Reject direct CAL,
PTC-disabled, missing-product, inferred no-op, and cross-generation routes before payload retrieval.
2. Stage B—safe numerical classiﬁcation. Retrieve only structurally admitted transformed-signal and coeﬃ-
cient payloads. Classify zi as ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite, or unrepresentable and γi as ﬁnite strictly positive, exact zero,
negative ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite, or unrepresentable. Verify coeﬃcient availability itself imposed no ﬁniteness require-
ment. Separately validate the exact observation-resolved coverage cut before application: zero, ordinary (0, 1],
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 4

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Engineering Conformance Speciﬁcation Document r0.4
above one admitted only by an independently authorized same-value/scope coverage_cut_above_one_override_
requested fact, or invalid when missing, non-ﬁnite, negative, or unrepresentable. The number above one never
authorizes itself. Invalid input fails before support construction, application, or mutation; no realized cut value
is a pre-application prerequisite.
3. Stage C—coordinate, product, and V AL decision. Evaluate exact AST coordinate validity, one-hot place-
ment/boundary, and only the companions required by the exact selected observation/coadd product role. To
produce a new V AL decision, ﬁrst verify exact proﬁle semantics, scientiﬁc-owner approval, canonical Registry
registration and source binding, activation/evaluability, and every required object fact. The current status is
given by the exact candidate proﬁle-status rule and permits no evaluation. After an exact active generation
exists, perform the evaluation; then verify the resulting decision-artifact identity, request, applicability, eligibility,
realization, exact causes, immutable reason, and failure scope. Only after that veriﬁcation may MAP consume the
decision for admission. When consuming an existing decision, verify its exact proﬁle/source binding, object iden-
tity, four-axis state, causes, and realization before MAP admission. Only requested/applicable/eligible/realized
passes. Verify separately that the PTC coeﬃcient/QC pass uses its exact PTC-owned proﬁle and neither replaces
nor rescues SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2.
4. Stages D and E—membership then accumulation. Construct membership only after Stages A–C and
perform no payload arithmetic until all required gates pass. Verify no numeric-zero mask, late masking, or
aggregate sanitization substitutes for admission. Then compare exact scientiﬁc output-row identity and cardi-
nality, plus one-pixel, one-hot half-open-boundary, prohibited-fractional, empty-support, covariance, ﬁxed-state
response, full-procedure comparison-space typing, and distinct-fact observation outputs, to independent expected
values; retained storage rows do not count as scientiﬁc output rows.
5. Exercise original-footprint exposure ﬁxtures: one original inﬂuencing several descendants at diﬀerent pixels; orig-
inal and descendants in diﬀerent pixels; missing original coordinate; boundary loss; multiple maps sharing one
original; distinct observations with numerically identical original coordinates; and donor/synthesized descendants.
Verify exact observation/UID/native/stable-ALIGN-slot/generation keys, layered AST ALIGN-grid parent in the
target WCS, one own-coordinate placement, separate inﬂuence edges, and no precision or temporal-support pro-
motion.
6. Verify complete immutable observation-bundle construction as a logical artifact. Independently request all three
observation roles and record each reached requested, eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized plan
stage and separate attempt outcome; a successful realization has all ﬁve, a pre-application stop has no ap-
plied/realized records, and a failed or no-support not-produced applied attempt has no realized product. Exercise
required publication for persisted routes plus explicitly selected in-memory and coadd-only routes. In-memory
retention is not a waived product.
7. Snapshot coadd-owned state; test every compatibility failure under each selected role; require atomic nonmutation.
Conﬁrm that base-permitted unavailable or basis-incompatible response and incomplete covariance preserve the
base signal membership and publish exact status/cause.
8. Conﬁrm that the candidate observation-coadd proﬁle cannot be evaluated before exact owner acceptance, Reg-
istry/source binding, and activation. After an active successor exists, evaluate all four object-decision axes
separately from the MAP lifecycle and attempt outcome; then independently request all three coadd roles and
exercise admitted centered-integer coaddition, exact coadd output-row identity, and companion placement. If
a canonical target grid was requested before observation-map construction, verify that every constructed map
honors it. Otherwise verify that already existing compatible bundles, including persisted coadd-only inputs, may
select a common coadd target and use exact centered-integer embedding without modifying or relabeling their
scientiﬁc samples. An explicit crop creates a new row-selected product with its own identity and provenance.
9. Round-trip all required representations and reconstruct each row-selected operator from provenance. Evalu-
ate the physical FITS and typed WCS on every preregistered scientiﬁcally addressable pixel center and every
outer-footprint cell vertex, including all corners, with the exact index mapping, common WCS generation/frame,
binary64 great-circle metric, and fail-on-invalid rule. Infer no continuum maximum from that ﬁnite population.
10. Exercise ﬁxed-state, PTC full-procedure, and PTC+MAP re-resolved response families. For every numerical ∆ z or
∆ m, require the complete baseline/perturbed identities, quantity/unit, rows, frames/WCS, reference/gauge/null
state, supports, coeﬃcient/response bases, exact common domain and both maps, unmatched-row treatment,
perturbation parameters, ﬁnite-diﬀerence convention, state transition, availability, and cause. Reject implicit
ﬁll, intersection, coordinate/shape/position association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment; a state
delta alone never authorizes subtraction. Require the stable SCI-MAP-FULL-PROCEDURE-COMPARISON-SPACE identity in
every such record. Reconstruct and disclose the complete MAP-local operator AMAP,Π , the immutable realized
plan Π , and row selector Jout with its exact output-row domain for every valid product, while marking coadd-
full-procedure/re-resolved and whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP responses unavailable unless separate
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 5

SCI-MAP v0.2 | Engineering Conformance Speciﬁcation Document r0.4
approved authorities establish them; exercise an already realized PTC-grid companion applied exactly once; and
honest response/covariance disclosure. For a response-bearing role, require only every exact response object named
by that role; absence of a diﬀerent unselected response family does not block it. For a response-bearing coadd,
require one exact shared family R, compatible source/perturbation/basis/unit/normalization/gauge/WCS/row
identities, ﬁxed membership/placement/Bout/support/coeﬃcients, and an exact composition theorem; reject mul-
tiplication of a ﬁnite diﬀerence through Bout as a Jacobian without that theorem. For coadd covariance, require
every block named by the selected covariance-qualiﬁed role before accepting the complete numerical propagation
and otherwise require partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable state on the base role.
Verify no stronger role subsets an existing base parent and verify versioned binding for later derivative products.
11. Exercise consumer claim boundaries and immutable base/unﬁltered MAP parentage without assuming a closed-
world registry of all future scientiﬁc uses. Verify that Pointing and OOF receive only permission to reuse the exact
ordinary MAP gridding operator when their inputs conform. Their WCS/frame, model/ﬁtting, interpretation,
outputs, defaults, proﬁles, and qualiﬁcation remain mode-owned, and no unsupplied mode proﬁle is activated.
12. Repeat supported execution modes under the preregistered ﬂoating-point policy, while requiring exact discrete
facts.
13. Only after deterministic gates pass, execute representation, external, observational, and operational evidence
appropriate to the requested claim.
For every failure-injection test, capture pre-state, attempted input, emitted diagnostic, post-state, publica-
tion/cardinality state, and completion state. No partial-state comparison may omit a coadd companion merely
because its payload was not the injected failure target.
4.1 Scope-discrimination cases
The following cases make the targeted r0.4 amendments discriminating. Each case records every reached requested,
eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state plus the separate attempt outcome, and asserts role-
qualiﬁed atomic nonmutation on rejection.
The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_
observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, SCI-MAP:response_bearing_
coadd@1, and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set, ordered
MAP lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not
rewrite that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance.

5 Canonical requirement conformance clauses
The following clauses are generated from the shared authority. The ﬁrst paragraph is the canonical science require-
ment; the second is its minimum conformance route. Every one of the 52 result ﬁelds is initialized to the exact value
not_assessed; this says applicable evidence has not yet been executed or reviewed and does not describe artifact
realization.

Canonical clause: The scientiﬁc contract version shall be v0.2. The rendered document revision shall be recorded separately
as r0.4; changing layout or exposition alone shall not be represented as a new scientiﬁc contract version.
Minimum conformance evidence: Inspect both artifacts and their machine-readable provenance for distinct contract-
version and document-revision ﬁelds.
Result: not_assessed

SCI-MAP-REQ-030 – Retained original-footprint exposure
Canonical clause: MAP retained_original_footprint_exposure shall use the same original-occurrence key and own-
coordinate placement as REQ-029, restricted to originals that are ancestors of estimator-admitted members. Overlapping
ﬁlters, decimation, replacement, synthesis, and multiple descendants do not duplicate seconds. Coadded exposure shall union
observation-scoped original identities after atomic coadd admission; one original can occupy at most one pixel under the base
one-hot family, or none after boundary loss. Neither exposure is precision.
Minimum conformance evidence: Use overlapping observation lineage, multiple descendants, mixed admission, donor
reuse, and boundary loss; compare exact original-key unions, pixel placement, and coadd sums.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-031 – Adopted threshold selector
Canonical clause: For each declared support-policy population, sort its ﬁnite strictly positive normalization coeﬃcients
Qp; for count N > 0, select zero-based k = ⌊(⌊0. 75N ⌋ + N )/ 2⌋ and Q⋆ = Q(k); for N = 0 , use the exact boundary
convention Q⋆ = 0, which selects no population element and never denotes a zero-sky measurement. The exact population and
policy identities and each reached requested, eﬀective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state/value of dimensionless
c = coverage_cut shall be retained; a successful realized product contains all ﬁve, while failure or nonproduction retains
only the reached preﬁx. Pre-application admission shall check the exact observation-resolved value. Application shall bind
that value to one support-policy attempt; realization shall later bind only an actual product. The exact Boolean plan fact
coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested shall bind request identity, authorized owner or proﬁle, scope, each reached
lifecycle stage, exact value, cause, and provenance. It has no applied/realized record before application and no realized record
after failure or nonproduction. The scalar shall be ﬁnite and nonnegative. Exact zero requests no relative cut while ﬁnite
strictly-positive Qp remains mandatory. Values 0 < c ≤ 1 are the ordinary recommended range. A value c > 1 is admissible
only when that independently authorized fact is true for the same resolved value and scope; the number cannot authorize
itself and may yield no support-authorized output rows. That prospective case is governed by the exact empty-support
disposition. Negative, non-ﬁnite, missing, or unrepresentable values shall fail before support-row construction, application, or
required-product mutation. No universal numerical default is established.
Minimum conformance evidence: Check N = 0 with exact Q⋆ = 0 and no selected element, and small N values around
every integer-index transition against the exact zero-based formula; verify each reached stage, all ﬁve only on successful product
realization, pre-application use of the resolved value, absence of future-stage placeholders, separate failed and not-produced
outcomes, exact-zero and ordinary endpoints, independently authorized above-one override with same-value/scope matching,
self-authorization rejection, prospective no-support nonproduction, and preconstruction nonmutation for every invalid state.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-032 – Separate support predicates
Canonical clause: Only after the eﬀective plan and exact observation-resolved cut pass REQ-031 shall application bind
capplied = cobservation_resolved for one support-policy attempt. Numerical normalization support shall then require ﬁnite positive
Qp ≥ Q⋆capplied/ 10, and science-policy support shall independently require ﬁnite positive Qp ≥ Q⋆capplied. Both comparisons
are inclusive and use the exact declared population and inherited order-statistic rule, including Q⋆ = 0 when N = 0 . At
c = 0 , no relative threshold excludes a row, but no zero, negative, non-ﬁnite, or absent Qp is restored. An authorized expert
c > 1 may leave the science-support set empty; the exact empty-support disposition governs that applied attempt. These
thresholds are an operational relative-support policy and imply no exposure, precision, signiﬁcance, response, completeness,
or physical optimality. Neither support state establishes ﬁnal validity or precision; no realized value is required to authorize
this pre-application check.
Minimum conformance evidence: Exercise values below, exactly at, and above both thresholds for empty and nonempty
populations; distinguish the N = 0 , Q⋆ = 0 boundary convention from any selected element or zero-sky measurement;
distinguish normalization from science support; verify resolved-to-applied equality, exact-zero behavior, no self-authorizing
above-one value, prospective no-support nonproduction, and no use of crealized as a prerequisite.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-033 – MAP-local base-product validity
Canonical clause: One MAP-local base-product scientiﬁc-validity state shall require membership in the exact support-
authorized row set, exact admitted PTC and AST parents, passing MAP contribution/support policy, ﬁnite normalized
signal, and absence of an applicable MAP-product failure. Explicitly limited or unavailable response/covariance does not
alone invalidate the map. An empty support-authorized row set realizes no MAP product and therefore has no base-product
validity state; the exact empty-support disposition governs it. Retained storage, ﬁnite payload, coeﬃcient, exposure, incidence,
normalization, or downstream-local eligibility cannot establish or rewrite MAP validity.
Minimum conformance evidence: Use truth-table ﬁxtures separating producer state, MAP admission, response/covariance
disclosure, base validity, later use-local eligibility, and the prospective no-support not-produced outcome with no validity state.
Result: not_assessed

SCI-MAP-REQ-034 – Classify before arithmetic
Canonical clause: Only structurally admitted payloads shall be retrieved and safely classiﬁed for ﬁniteness/sign before
membership construction. All required gates shall pass before payload arithmetic. Multiplication by zero, masking after
accumulation, or sanitizing a non-ﬁnite aggregate shall not substitute for admission.
Minimum conformance evidence: Place NaN and Inf payloads behind structural false and true predicates; verify no
unauthorized read, exact numerical classiﬁcation when authorized, no contamination, diagnostics, and failure scope.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-035 – Exceptional contribution states
Canonical clause: Zero coeﬃcient shall be noncontributing, a low positive coeﬃcient shall follow the explicit adopted policy,
negative or non-ﬁnite ordinary coeﬃcients shall be invalid, and an out-of-bounds projection shall contribute nowhere. Each
cause shall remain distinguishable.
Minimum conformance evidence: Run one-cause-at-a-time ﬁxtures and inspect cause-speciﬁc states plus unchanged
neighboring pixels.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-036 – Complete observation bundle and roles
Canonical clause: The six independently requestable product roles are SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:response_
bearing_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_map@1, SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, SCI-MAP:response_
bearing_coadd@1, and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1. Every request has its own immutable identity, parent set,
ordered MAP lifecycle, result, and failure scope. A stronger role is a new product over the exact base parent; it does not
rewrite that parent’s signal membership, response/covariance status, validity, or provenance. A SCI-MAP:base_observation_
map@1 shall exist as one immutable ordered logical bundle before coaddition only when actual support-authorized scientiﬁc
rows and product values were realized. It contains signal, numerator, normalization identity, complete MAP-local realized
operator identity, honest upstream-response and uncertainty/covariance identity and status, the distinct facts in REQ-025,
exposure lineage/accounting identity, unit and exact nominal-beam parent, complete AST frame/WCS, shape/indexing,
estimator/projection/proﬁle identities, PTC removed-component/additive-reference/null-space state, all ﬁve MAP lifecycle
stages, successful attempt outcome, exact PTC/AST parentage, and product identity. It may remain valid when a stronger
numerical upstream response or complete covariance is unavailable; those permitted companion statuses are not attempt
failure. Independently requested SCI-MAP:response_bearing_observation_map@1 and SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_observation_
map@1 products shall each parent the exact realized base observation, bind their own lifecycle and attempt outcome, and
require respectively every named exact response-family object or every named within-observation covariance block. An
applied no-support attempt creates no logical observation bundle. Physical persistence is separately controlled by the eﬀective
output plan.
Minimum conformance evidence: Request each observation role independently; remove or alter each required iden-
tity/companion; distinguish absent declarations, honest unavailable companion states, failed attempts, and no-support non-
production; verify role-speciﬁc failure without base-parent mutation; and verify identical scientiﬁc content and identity for
in-memory and faithfully persisted forms.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-037 – Role-qualiﬁed atomic coadd admission
Canonical clause: After exact owner acceptance, canonical Registry/source binding, and activation make
SCI-MAP:observation_coadd_admission@2 evaluable, a complete realized observation bundle shall pass every compatibility check
and only the companion checks required by the exact selected product role before any coadd-owned state changes. This r0.4 can-
didate has no active proﬁle or object-speciﬁc decision. Under SCI-MAP:base_coadd@1, unavailable or basis-incompatible response
and incomplete covariance do not alter signal membership and do not reject an otherwise compatible base bundle; their exact
identities, states, and causes remain. A required companion incompatibility is atomically decisive only for SCI-MAP:response_
bearing_coadd@1 or SCI-MAP:covariance_qualified_coadd@1 as applicable. If an exact base coadd parent already exists, such an
incompatibility blocks the stronger role for that parent and never selects a subset. A separately requested stronger-role admis-
sion may reject an observation only before constructing its own explicitly identiﬁed base/signal parent. Every rejection leaves
all aﬀected numerators, normalizations, counts, exposure, response, validity, provenance, and product cardinality unchanged.
Minimum conformance evidence: First verify all six proﬁle-status axes and require no evaluation while activation is
unavailable; after an exact active generation exists, snapshot all role-owned and base-parent state, inject one base fact,
response-family, and covariance incompatibility at a time, and verify role-speciﬁc admission, exact pre-mutation rejection,
unchanged base membership, and no companion-only subset.
Result: not_assessed

SCI-MAP-REQ-038 – Centered integer common grid
Canonical clause: A canonical target grid may be requested and made immutable before observation-map construction.
Observation maps constructed on that exact grid, or otherwise compatible observation/coadd shapes, shall use exact centered-
integer embedding: shape diﬀerences are nonnegative and even in each axis, and the corresponding integer oﬀset maps reference
pixels to the same world coordinate. A later crop is a newly identiﬁed row-selected product with immutable parent and lineage;
it shall not relabel the parent or make it retrospectively compatible. Fractional shift, post-hoc pad, reprojection, interpolation,
wrapping, implicit recentering, mosaicking, and a diﬀerent sky grid are outside this estimator.
Minimum conformance evidence: Test preconstruction target-grid requests, every parity/sign case and WCS reference-
pixel relation, exact integer embedding, a separately identiﬁed post-hoc crop, attempted parent relabeling, and each excluded
grid-changing operation.
Result: not_assessed

or not-produced attempt instead binds only the reached lifecycle preﬁx, attempt identity/outcome, exact cause, aﬀected
scope, provenance, and nonmutation evidence and has no product identity or completion marker. No STOKES token supplies
quantity authority. Scientiﬁc identity shall be durable without prescribing a persistence format.
Minimum conformance evidence: Round-trip every role, lifecycle, attempt outcome, parent, membership, response family,
comparison-space, and override identity through prospective in-memory and persisted representations; detect collisions or

SCI-MAP-REQ-044 – F rames and units
Canonical clause: MAP shall bind the complete frame identity delivered by SCI-AST:rtc_output_grid_coordinates@1: ex-
act source/target frame, reference system (including ICRS or FK5/J2000 as actually declared), equinox/epoch, time scale,
site/model state, TAN topology, WCS, axis order, signs, handedness, and degree-valued science axes. MAP shall not equate
J2000, FK5, ICRS, apparent, observed, or unrefracted frames by name or default. Signal/response units are mJy/beam with
exact nominal-beam identity; covariance has its square.
Minimum conformance evidence: Inspect complete frame and unit/beam identity and require cross-frame, ambiguous-
frame, cross-unit, or cross-beam coadd rejection.
Result: not_assessed

before application. A terminal failure retains the applied attempt and failure evidence without a realized product; an applied
no-support outcome retains its exact proof and cause with not_produced outcome and no failure or realized product.
Minimum conformance evidence: Reconstruct each reached lifecycle stage, attempt outcome, role/parent, row-selected

Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-047 – F ailure scope, nonproduction, and atomicity
Canonical clause: An invalid required input, unauthorized above-one cut, incompatible bundle, unrepresentable ﬁnite
aggregate, unrepresentable coordinate/index conversion, missing companion required by the exact selected role, or failed
required publication shall propagate at its declared contribution, pixel, observation-admission, or complete-product scope and
shall fail before the aﬀected live state changes. A pre-application failure creates no applied or realized record. A failure
after application retains the exact applied attempt, failure stage, cause, aﬀected scope, and nonmutation evidence without
fabricating a realized product or completion marker. A valid applied policy yielding no support-authorized output rows
is instead not_produced with cause no_support_authorized_output_rows; it is not failure and publishes no map, coadd
member, response, covariance, or completion marker. Base-role response/covariance unavailability permitted by REQ-037–041
is a realized companion-status fact, not producer or attempt failure.
Minimum conformance evidence: Inject each failure class and the separate prospective no-support case under every
product role at its exact boundary; inspect scope, lifecycle, attempt outcome, diagnostics/evidence, nonmutation, unchanged
base parent, and absence of false application, realization, product identity, or completion.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-048 – Required observation products
Canonical clause: A complete realized logical SCI-MAP:base_observation_map@1 bundle with at least one support-authorized
scientiﬁc row shall exist before coaddition. For an applied observation attempt with no such rows, the exact empty-support
disposition applies, and the attempt is not an admitted coadd member. Persisted per-observation products are the normal
scientiﬁc expectation and shall be published whenever the eﬀective v0.2 output plan designates them required; every required
publication shall complete or the declared operation fails without a completion claim. A plan may instead permit a fully
in-memory route. A coadd-only entry may consume persisted conforming observation bundles without rerunning upstream
processing. In-memory and persisted routes shall use identical logical admission, arithmetic, role and base-parent identity,
lifecycle, attempt outcome, and provenance. Optional nonpublication of a realized logical product does not imply that the
product did not exist; no-support nonproduction means that no logical observation product exists. This MAP rule does not
waive PTC’s upstream atomic required-publication obligations.

Minimum conformance evidence: Exercise required-publication success/failure, optional in-memory nonpublication,

bundle content across storage routes, exclusion of a no-row attempt from coadd membership, exact failure propagation, no
misleading realization/completion, and unchanged upstream PTC duties.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-049 – Immutable base parent
Canonical clause: Every stronger observation/coadd role and downstream transformation shall preserve the exact resolvable
base/unﬁltered MAP-bundle or base-coadd identity, ordered membership, lifecycle, and MAP-local base-product validity. A
later local validity/eligibility decision may diﬀer for its named use but shall not rewrite MAP validity, alter the original claims,
sever parentage, or select a hidden subset of an existing base parent. Later response or covariance estimates are new versioned
products.
Minimum conformance evidence: Create stronger roles and later locally eligible products over MAP-invalid and MAP-
valid parents; verify exact membership, both validity states, parentage, and original claims remain immutable.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-050 – Complete consumer boundary
Canonical clause: No consumer shall receive a bare signal plane as a scientiﬁcally complete map. The boundary
shall include exact product role, request, base parent and membership; quantity and nominal-beam identity; estima-
tor/normalization/coeﬃcient/proﬁle identity; honest response class/state and uncertainty/covariance disclosure; distinct map
and exposure facts; PTC additive-reference/removed-component/null-space state; exact frame/WCS, shape/indexing, all
reached lifecycle stages, parentage, dependency versions, comparison-space record when applicable, and failures. Later anal-
yses choose their own exact claim requirements and may attach honest versioned response/covariance products; MAP does
not own their eligibility. SCI-NOI owns its exact realization-generation, empirical-uncertainty, conditional-scale, and stan-
dardization methods and products. Any physical- noise, total-uncertainty, covariance-completeness, signiﬁcance, probability,
false-rate, completeness, purity, or catalogue interpretation requires a separately approved exact method and remains unavail-
able by default. MAP therefore keeps Q normalization, formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, the
NOI conditional_detector_sign_randomization_marginal_second_moment, the NOI standardized signal, and any future
calibrated-signiﬁcance method as distinct identities and claims.
Minimum conformance evidence: Exercise every role and claims with missing required facts, including NOI-related claims
and analyses that explicitly accept limitations; verify fail-closed claim scope, exact parent/membership, and no rewrite of MAP
validity.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-051 – Same ﬁxed noise operator
Canonical clause: An admitted noise realization may be described as using the same map/coadd operator only when
eligibility, projection, grouping, coeﬃcients, normalization, exact support-authorized row selection, boundary, and atomic
coadd admission are ﬁxed or identically prescribed. Re-estimation from the randomized data deﬁnes a diﬀerent named
estimator.
Minimum conformance evidence: Propagate ﬁxed deterministic vectors through signal and realization paths and compare
row identities and operator coeﬃcients, not ﬁlenames or shapes.
Result: not_assessed
SCI-MAP-REQ-052 – Method and claim separation
Canonical clause: Pointing and OOF may be registered consumers of the exact ordinary MAP gridding operator only
when their inputs satisfy this operator contract. Reuse grants no mode-speciﬁc WCS/frame, source model, ﬁtting, response
interpretation, output, default, or qualiﬁcation authority; an unsupplied mode proﬁle remains unavailable. This authority shall
not otherwise be applied by analogy to JINC, maximum-likelihood mapmaking, OOF residual transfer, reprojection, ﬁltering,
empirical noise, ﬁtting, Beammap inference, feedback, Stokes Q/U, measured-R mapmaking, or other units. Independent
inspection, modiﬁcation, experimentation, and proposal remain unrestricted, while an altered scientiﬁc identity or oﬃcial claim
requires an explicit versioned successor and evidence appropriate to that claim. Algebraic contract correctness, engineering
conformance, representation/response ﬁdelity, observational performance, and production readiness shall remain separate
claims.
Minimum conformance evidence: Exercise conforming and nonconforming Pointing/OOF operator requests, missing mode
proﬁles, each prohibited method/claim promotion, and an independently changed support algorithm; verify exact operator
reuse boundaries, unavailable unsupplied authority, versioned identity, and independent claim-state ﬁelds.
Result: not_assessed

6 Prediction execution matrix
Predictions are imported from the same shared authority. Engineering records attach ﬁxtures, bounds, artifacts, and
results; they do not rewrite the prediction.
SCI-MAP-PRED-001 – Uniform constant
Canonical prediction: For ﬁxed membership, a constant admitted input with uniform positive coeﬃcients produces
that constant on every support-authorized MAP-valid output row; numerator and normalization scale together, and
no unsupported scientiﬁc row is created.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-002 – Unequally weighted constant
Canonical prediction: For ﬁxed membership, unequal positive coeﬃcients still preserve the same constant on every
support-authorized output row, while normalization and conditional variance generally change with position; rows
outside that set have no normalized scientiﬁc value.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-003 – One-pixel hand calculation
Canonical prediction: For an authorized row with admitted zi and ai > 0, the exact triplet is (N, Q, ˆm) =
(∑ aizi, ∑ ai, ∑ aizi/ ∑ ai); an unauthorized row has no normalized scientiﬁc value.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-004 – One-hot boundary
Canonical prediction: A ﬁnite coordinate inside exactly one half-open cell has one Gpi = 1 , preserves unity over
pixels, and contributes only there. A coordinate on an internal upper edge belongs to the adjacent cell; a coordinate
on the outer upper extent or outside the grid contributes nowhere. Fractional splitting is not authorized.
Primary claim layer: Algebraic contract.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-005 – Delta input
Canonical prediction: For a declared ﬁxed state, a basis-pixel sky perturbation produces the corresponding
support-row-restricted column of Rﬁxed,Θ = AMAP,Π Hﬁxed,Θ , including projection and boundary truncation. A PTC
full-procedure or PTC+MAP re-resolved numerical diﬀerence exists only when its complete authorized comparison-
space record supplies exact common domains and both row maps; absent that record it is unavailable or only a typed
state transition/discontinuity and need not equal the ﬁxed-state column.
Primary claim layer: Representation ﬁdelity.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-006 – Point-source template
Canonical prediction: A declared point-source perturbation τb produces Rﬁxed,Θ τb only for the exact ﬁxed re-
sponse state and authorized rows. PTC full-procedure and PTC+MAP re-resolved families additionally retain base-
line/perturbed identities, perturbation side/sign/amplitude/location/source state/normalization, ﬁnite-diﬀerence
convention, gauge/support/bases, exact common domain and row maps, state transition, availability, and cause.
The unavailable whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP family is not inferred. Peak, integrated, and ﬁtted am-
plitudes remain distinct functionals.
Primary claim layer: Representation ﬁdelity.

SCI-MAP-PRED-010 – Coeﬃcient states
Canonical prediction: The admitted uniform family yields exact dimensionless γi = 1 only for an explicit selection
with complete PTC publication, exact target/payload/occurrence association, MAP permission, and a requested, ap-
plicable, eligible, realized named handoﬀ under the exact compatible source binding. Registry presence alone realizes
nothing. Missing selection or handoﬀ remains unavailable with no fallback. Structural availability is independent
of numerical class; MAP alone classiﬁes ﬁnite positive, exact zero, negative ﬁnite, non-ﬁnite, and unrepresentable.
Zero is noncontributing and the other nonpositive/non-ﬁnite classes are invalid with exact cause; uniform one is not
precision.

Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

SCI-MAP-PRED-012 – Threshold selector
Canonical prediction: For each predeclared positive ﬁnite coeﬃcient population, the selected zero-based index is
exactly ⌊(⌊0. 75N ⌋+ N )/ 2⌋; empty input uses the exact boundary convention Q⋆ = 0 while selecting no population
element and asserting no zero-sky measurement. No row gains support without its own ﬁnite positive Qp. Small
N ﬁxtures straddle every integer-index transition. At exact c = 0 , both relative thresholds are zero and the ﬁnite-
positive requirement still excludes zero, negative, non-ﬁnite, or absent normalization. Values 0 < c ≤ 1 use inclusive
comparisons in the ordinary recommended range. A c > 1 value is admitted only with the independently true,
same-value/scope coverage_cut_above_one_override_requested fact and may yield empty support; the number
does not authorize itself. That prospective applied case has state applied_no_support_authorized_output_rows,
outcome not_produced, exact cause no_support_authorized_output_rows, no failure, and no realized MAP prod-
uct. Negative, non-ﬁnite, missing, or unrepresentable c fails before application or required-product mutation. Every
reached cut stage is retained, with all ﬁve only for successful product realization; pre-application validation checks
the observation-resolved value and never requires a realized value.

decision.

SCI-MAP-PRED-017 – Missing, invalid, or no-support observation
Canonical prediction: An unsupported observation row contributes at no coadd row; an observation rejected by

its count. An applied observation attempt with no support-authorized output rows has outcome not_produced, is
not an admitted coadd member, and has no signal, response, covariance, exposure, count, validity, or completion
product. A companion unavailable but permitted by a realized base role does not remove the observation and is not
attempt failure. No case creates a zero-valued scientiﬁc or companion substitute.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.
Fixture / bound / result: not_assessed; preregistration pending
SCI-MAP-PRED-018 – Centered integer placement

bound to that grid. Other compatible shape diﬀerences that are nonnegative and even produce the exact half-

FITS representation comparison evaluates every preregistered addressable pixel center and outer-boundary cell vertex,
including all corners, with the exact spherical metric and invalid-point rule. A later crop is a new row-selected product
with its own identity and lineage and cannot relabel its parent as compatible.
Primary claim layer: Engineering conformance.

SCI-MAP-PRED-025 – Quantity-speciﬁc zero, index, and no-support outcomes
Canonical prediction: A ﬁnite exact-zero signal numerator Np = 0 with ﬁnite positive normalization Qp > 0,
valid support, and every other required gate passing is admissible and gives the valid normalized scientiﬁc value
ˆmp = 0 . An in-bounds zero-based index and a zero centered-integer placement oﬀset are valid when their exact
domain and embedding rules pass. A row with Qp = 0 is outside ﬁnite-positive normalization support: division is
unauthorized and no supported scientiﬁc row is formed. This normalization-speciﬁc result is not a generic rule that
zero is invalid. A zero coeﬃcient remains noncontributing; coverage_cut = 0 retains its no-relative-cut meaning;
and support-population count N = 0 retains Q⋆ = 0 while selecting no population element and authorizing no row by
itself. Non-ﬁnite, overﬂowed, out-of-domain, and unrepresentable quantities follow their exact declared failure scopes
before aﬀected mutation or completion. Separately, a valid applied policy whose support-authorized output-row set

7 Mechanical completeness checks
Before a conformance verdict, automated checks shall establish:
• exactly one declaration of each stable requirement and prediction ID in the shared authority, with no gaps or
duplicates;
• every requirement appears in this speciﬁcation and in CROSSWALK.md; every prediction is linked to at least one
requirement;
• lifecycle, attempt outcome, empty-support disposition, six proﬁle-status axes, exact response-family coadd con-
struction, the stable comparison-space record, NOI terminology, and document-authority roles agree across the
core, three views, records, proﬁles, bindings, and prospective templates;
• each rendered PDF identiﬁes contract v0.2 and its current document revision separately;
• no unresolved LaTeX reference, citation, overfull box, clipped glyph, broken table, or unreadable page remains;
• every required artifact reopens successfully, has the expected page count, and renders every page through an
independent PDF renderer; and
• the owner-decision ledger and author-draft decision record contain no silent resolution of an open scientiﬁc ques-
tion.
The conformance verdict uses the same exact ﬁve-value requirement-result vocabulary. It is pass only when every
applicable requirement is pass on the exact candidate. Any contradictory evaluated requirement makes it fail;
otherwise any missing named prerequisite makes it blocked; otherwise any applicable unevaluated requirement
makes it not_assessed. not_applicable is permitted only for a requirement outside the exact candidate’s declared
role with an owner-approved rationale. Evidence-artifact incomplete is never a requirement result. This document
records every placeholder as not_assessed and asserts no verdict.
Required handoﬀ contents
An engineering handoﬀ contains the candidate and authority identities; requirement result table using exactly
pass, fail, blocked, not_applicable, and not_assessed; a separate artifact-realization ﬁeld using exactly
complete, incomplete, failed, and not_produced; a separate MAP attempt outcome using succeeded, failed,
and not_produced; product-realization identity only for actual products; prediction result table; exact commands
and environment; independent expected-value artifacts; build/test/log outputs; representation and observational
evidence where claimed; failure-injection snapshots; skipped/blocked items; deviations and owner dispositions; and
an explicit statement for each claim layer. The handoﬀ shall not collapse “conforms algebraically,” “represents
faithfully,” “performs on sky,” and “ready for production” into one status word.
Procedure only | conformance not_assessed Page 27
